== Biography ==
'''Jojo''' is from Niterói, Rio de Janeiro.

== Trivia ==
* There's a running gag among the community that he has a elderly and grumpy personality.<ref>[https://twitter.com/REDCanids/status/1770141671663022536 RED Canids' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* He revealed in a interview to [[Fogueta]] after winning the [[LTA South 2025 Split 2 Playoffs|LTA South]] that he almost considered retiring in the previous year but got supported by [[RedBert]] to not retire and continue competing.
* In a interview to [[LeonButcher]], he revealed that he was left out of [[RED Canids]] in 2024 after the team left the decision of which support to play with [[Brance]].
